title: Grilled Pork Skewers Italian Style
description: Tender and flavorful grilled pork skewers infused with the bright, herby flavors of Italy. Perfect for a summer evening meal.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality pork shoulder for the best flavor

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: chopped fresh rosemary
ingredients.notes: Choose fresh rosemary for the best flavor

ingredients.name: garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality, fresh garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, flaky sea salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, homemade Italian seasoning blend for the best flavor

instructions: Thread pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, rosemary, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the pork skewers, making sure they're evenly coated.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and lightly charred.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh rosemary and lemon wedges if desired.
